title: Security & DPA walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope
text:
Security & DPA walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope

["From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>\\nTo: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@acme-inc.com>; Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-inc.com>\\nCc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-07-12T09:15:00-07:00\\nSubject: Security & DPA walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope\\n\\nHi Adam / Priya —\\n\\nThanks for taking the time to coordinate this. Per our procurement thread, we'd like to schedule a 45-minute security/compliance walkthrough to cover: SOC 2 posture, our proposed pen test scope, and the DPA redline items you flagged.\\n\\nProposed slots (PDT):\\n- Tue Jul 14, 10:00–10:45 AM\\n- Tue Jul 14, 2:30–3:15 PM\\n- Wed Jul 15, 9:00–9:45 AM\\n\\nAttendees from our side: Monica (Security Lead), Karthik (Solutions/pen-test scope), and myself (Customer Success). If there are additional folks on your side (legal, infra), please let me know who should be on the call.\\n\\nI'll attach a short SOC 2 summary and a first-pass pen test scope for your review before we meet.\\n\\nAttachments: SOC2_summary.pdf; PenTest_Scope_v1.docx\\n\\nThanks,\\nSoojin Lee\\nSenior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference\\nsoojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198\\nRedwood Inference — Production-first inference platform\\n\\n", "From: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@acme-inc.com>\\nTo: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-inc.com>\\nCc: security-team@acme-inc.com\\nDate: 2026-07-12T12:03:00-07:00\\nSubject: Re: Security & DPA walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope\\n\\nHi Soojin —\\n\\nThanks for the options. Tue Jul 14 at 2:30 PM PDT works best for us but Priya has a quick conflict at the start of the slot and asked if we can shift to 2:45 PM (ends 3:30 PM). Would that be possible?\\n\\nAlso, our security team would like to confirm you can share the SOC 2 summary in advance (we've assigned a reviewer). If you have any existing pen test scopes/examples that align to SaaS inference platforms that would be helpful.\\n\\nAttendees on our side: Adam Lewis (infra), Priya Rao (legal), Security Team (security@acme-inc.com) — we may add one more infra engineer; I'll update once confirmed.\\n\\n– Adam\\nAdam Lewis\\nDirector, Infrastructure | Acme Inc.\\nadam.lewis@acme-inc.com\\n\\n", "From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>\\nTo: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@acme-inc.com>\\nCc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-inc.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-07-12T12:20:00-07:00\\nSubject: Re: Security & DPA walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope\\n\\nHi Adam —\\n\\n2:45 PM PDT on Tue Jul 14 works for us. I'll send a calendar invite for 2:45–3:30 PM PDT and include dial-in/Zoom details.\\n\\nMonica/Karthik — heads up: please review the attached pen test scope and SOC 2 summary before EOD Mon so we can address any open items during the call. Karthik, can you include the recommended testing windows and whether we should expect any short maintenance impact?\\n\\nI'll also attach a DPA redline (we received a couple comments from legal yesterday). Priya/Adam — feel free to circulate any additional reading or internal reviewers.\\n\\nThanks,\\nSoojin\\n\\n", "From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>\\nTo: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-07-13T08:07:00-07:00\\nSubject: Re: Security & DPA walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope (internal)\\n\\nInternal note —\\n\\nThanks for the ping. I'll be on the call on Tue 7/14 2:45 PM PDT. Quick checklist for the meeting:\\n- Bring SOC 2 scoping slide (summary + last attestation date)\\n- Call out encryption at rest/in transit and KMS integration options\\n- Confirm logs retention and access for auditors (we currently retain 12 months by default)\\n- Pen test scope: recommend non-production test window and a brief runbook for safe testing (no load tests against production models)\\n\\nKarthik, can you confirm if any customers have required a live pen test against production? If not, we will recommend a staging-based test and provide sample test cases.\\n\\nMonica Patel\\nSecurity Lead | Redwood Inference\\nmonica.patel@redwood.com\\n\\n", "From: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@acme-inc.com>\\nTo: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>\\nCc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-inc.com>, security-team@acme-inc.com\\nDate: 2026-07-13T10:45:00-07:00\\nSubject: Re: Security & DPA walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope\\n\\nPerfect — thanks for confirming, Soojin and Monica. A couple quick asks before the call:\\n1) Can you send the SOC 2 summary PDF and the pen test scope document to security@acme-inc.com so our reviewers can start looking?\\n2) Would you also share the DPA redline (we'll have legal look prior to the walkthrough)?\\n\\nIf you can provide those by EOD Mon (Jul 13), we'll be ready for a productive session.\\n\\nI'll loop in our infra engineer if needed tomorrow.\\n\\n– Adam\\n\\n", 'From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>\\nTo: Adam Lewis <adam.lewis@acme-inc.com>, security-team@acme-inc.com, Priya Rao <priya.rao@acme-inc.com>\\nCc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>\\nDate: 2026-07-14T16:02:00-07:00\\nSubject: Final: Security & DPA walkthrough — SOC 2 + pen test scope (calendar invite + docs)\\n\\nHi all —\\n\\nThanks — attachments below and calendar invite has been sent for Tue Jul 14, 2:45–3:30 PM PDT (Zoom). Join here: https://zoom.us/j/0000000000?pwd=example (calendar event: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=zoom-placeholder-20260714).\\n\\nAttached:\\n- SOC2_summary.pdf (PDF): high-level attestation date, control categories, auditor name\\n- PenTest_Scope_v1.docx (DOCX): recommended scope, testing windows, sample test cases, and safety runbook\\n- DPA_redline_20260713.pdf (PDF): our suggested redlines and comment history\\n\\nKarthik — note in the pen test scope doc I added a short section "Recommended non-prod test harness" (page 3). Monica and I flagged the encryption & logging bullets.\\n\\nIf anything changes on your side, send a quick note and we\'ll adjust — otherwise we\'ll plan to cover the three areas listed in the first email and leave 10 minutes for next steps (action items, follow-ups, DocuSign links for DPA if legal is aligned).\\n\\nSee you on Tue —\\nSoojin Lee\\nSenior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference\\nsoojin.lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0198\\n\\nAttachments: SOC2_summary.pdf; PenTest_Scope_v1.docx; DPA_redline_20260713.pdf\\n\\n']
